column1: # Rows db.device.* (line RG item T6a fix 1, 2026-11-17): the report goes to a device that fails; the covers cell names the device (`device: MODE`, db_search_fixtures.py `run_on_device`) and the frozen bytes are the NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 exit status, stderr and what reached the device.

# Rows db.device.*merged* (line RG item T8a, 2026-11-25): device out-stdout-merged (-out /dev/stdout, standard output a pipe, standard error into it): the frozen .out is NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's merged stream, which places each text after NCBI's last write of the -out file.

# Rows db.device.*.apost.* (line RG item T8f, 2026-11-28): outfmt 11 with -out /dev/full where the archive's stream replaces a byte of a query or subject title (`Error: (803.7)`, inputs tests/db_search/apost): NCBI's handler saves that post, the application's ResetMessages drops it after a written archive (only `Close`'s flush failed) and keeps it after the archive's messages where the write throws, so the error archive and its write fault (`error at byte N`) count it; with -import_search_strategy (the strategy's warnings first), two query batches (BATCH_SIZE) and psiblast's rounds.
